speaker: therapist
text: Hello Meena garu, I am the developmental paediatrician. Tell me what worries you about Asha.

speaker: parent
text: She is four years old and her sleep is very poor. She wakes up three or four times every night.

speaker: therapist
text: How long has the night waking been going on?

speaker: parent
text: For about six months, since we moved house. During the day she is very restless.

speaker: therapist
text: Is she taking any medicines now, and does she have any allergies?

speaker: parent
text: No medicines now. She is allergic to amoxicillin, she got a rash.

speaker: therapist
text: On examination she is active, makes brief eye contact and her growth is normal for her age.

speaker: therapist
text: During play she asked me for the bubbles with two words three times.

speaker: therapist
text: My impression is a sleep onset and night waking problem, and I want to check for low iron.

speaker: therapist
text: Plan: we will check a blood count and ferritin. Start melatonin two milligram tablet, one tablet by mouth thirty minutes before bed, for thirty days.

speaker: therapist
text: Keep a fixed bedtime routine with no screens for one hour before bed.

speaker: therapist
text: Please come back for follow up in four weeks with a sleep diary.
